{{Quote|If Rex's scans of the planet were ''accurate'', the pod should be on the top of the ''ridge''.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Hunted (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.16|Hunted (comic story)}}</ref>}}
'''Asuin''' was a frost-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] that was populated by [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]]. While the surface was besieged by icestorms, there were underground caverns filled with lava.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General's]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] with the task of recovering the stolen location of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[hypermatter generator]]s. The plans were present within a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] known as [[J-3PO]]. The two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] managed to find the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the underground caverns but it was destroyed by the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].
